notes_for_editor: NHL nomination (c.2000) is the backbone; its page numbers come from the page headers in the text. Conflicts: first lit 21 Dec 1771 vs establishment 1773 (Bulletin 1932, NHL p.10); federal takeover 1789 (p.17) vs June 1790 (p.10); Signal Service discontinued March 1885 (p.18) vs 2 Nov 1885 (p.11); 1932 candlepower 70,000 (NHL) vs 160,000 (Bulletin). NHL says north-tower beacon discontinued 1894 in a comparison passage that appears to concern Navesink. Keeper 'John Parley' d. 1891 per NHL; roster has John Farley first assistant 1891: identity not asserted. Wheeler and Bray surnames repeat, no kinship stated. LHB 1894/1897/1900 fog-signal figures not given page numbers (cited by volume). Bulletin 1921 geese event date read from OCR ('December 3 1, ...'): 31 Dec 1920 inferred from report dated 3 Jan 1921; check image. USLHS ownership says Town of Rockport; NHL (c.2000) says Coast Guard south end pending transfer: current owner of south tower not verified. 'Tarr 31 years' computed from roster. Newspapers (Chronicling America) yielded nothing useful.
